title: Liouville theorem for a class of p-Laplace type equations on manifolds
summary: We study a class of $p$-Laplace equations $$Δ_p u-λu^{p-1}+ u^{q-1}=0$$ on a closed $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ with $\operatorname{Ric}\geqslant(n-1)g$. For $1 2$ and $p 0$; aside from the constant solution, the equation admits a positive nonconstant solution. This answers Véron's problem raised in \cite{Ver92}.
